results.name: HSBC Fund and Fly: Earn Up to 200,000 Bonus Miles - Newsy Today
results.content:
According to HSBC Singapore filings, the bank has renewed its Fund and Fly campaign until September 30, 2026, introducing stricter maintenance terms while expanding eligible product classes to include investments and insurance. Under the updated promotion running from August 1 to September 30, 2026, new Everyday Global Account (EGA) holders depositing between $50,000 and $600,000 in fresh funds can earn from 12,000 up to 200,000 bonus miles.
## Extended Maintenance Period and Product Flexibility  
Compared to the April launch edition, the fresh fund maintenance period has increased from three months to five months, according to program updates. For an EGA opened in August 2026, funds must be deposited by August 31, 2026, and maintained until January 31, 2027, with bonus points credited by March 31, 2027.  
However, participants are no longer restricted solely to low-yielding bank deposits. Fresh funds can now be placed into eligible investment or insurance products to meet the threshold, according to campaign guidelines. Eligible categories include unit trusts, bonds, structured products, equities, foreign exchange transactions, Dual Currency Plus, and single or regular-premium insurance policies. Exclusions apply to products cancelled within cooling-off periods, CPF-linked investments, instruments without an initial sales charge, and specified money market funds like the Fullerton SGD Cash Fund and various HSBC liquidity funds.
## Comparison with SingSaver and Premier Mastercard Offers  
The revival of Fund and Fly coincides with a reduction in the welcome bonus for the HSBC Premier Mastercard, which was cut to 58,200 bonus miles and a $200 Apple voucher for applications submitted between August 1 and September 30, 2026, with a cap of 800 applicants, according to bank notices.  
New HSBC Premier customers can stack the Premier Mastercard welcome bonus with Fund and Fly. A deposit of $200,000 yields a combined 118,200 bonus miles plus the $200 Apple voucher. Alternatively, applicants can bypass Fund and Fly to choose a SingSaver sign-up promotion requiring a $300,000 deposit, which awards a choice of $1,600 cash, an Apple MacBook Air 15.3-inch (M4), or 105,000 Max Miles, according to campaign terms.  
**Did you know?** HSBC Point transfers are free of charge and processed instantly for most partners, though Hainan Fortune Wings Club and Japan Airlines Mileage Bank require up to 5 and 10 business days respectively, according to the bank’s loyalty rules.
